text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's the day of the Spring Fan Fest, an event which promotes interaction between the students and their fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I catch sight of Yaeno Muteki by the front gates, handing out brochures.
choice_data_list: Hey. Are you helping with student council stuff?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Good afternoon, Trainer. No, it's nothing of the sort.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I had free time, so I started standing here in the hopes of interacting with my fans. I thought these brochures might come in handy.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, Yaeno Muteki?! Hello! I watch all your races and concerts!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your support.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text: I absolutely love how gallant you are, both on the track and on stage! You're so awesome!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, and uh…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text: Er… I-I'll be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I haven't been able to maintain one conversation with a fan since I started standing here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, yer not exactly the most chummy of people, are ya?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ya gotta remember that we're used to dealin' with fans, but they're not used to talkin' to us, so they tend to lose their nerves. 'Specially in first meetings.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Plus, that grim martial artist vibe ya give off's no joke.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross and Inari One happen to overhear our conversation and decide to chime in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're both thoughtful and considerate, so they must have noticed Yaeno Muteki's struggles and decided to offer some advice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh! I see… I suppose it's true I haven't exactly been doing my best to be "chummy"…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Still, it wouldn't really be like you to force yourself to be all buddy-buddy either.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: For sure. Your brusque nature's what makes you, you. It's also probably what the fans wanna see.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Y'know what? Why don't we try makin' the most of that hard-to-approach aura of yours?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: No time for questions! Just follow me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Come one, come all! Try your hand at a no-holds-barred game of President! We've even got a prize for the winner!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Which one of ya brave souls're willin' to face Yaeno Muteki, da undefeated Peerless Poker Face herself?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: A no-holds-barred competition against Yaeno Muteki?! I must seize this opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan C
text_block_list.text: Man, Yaeno Muteki's so awesome when she gets fired up! If it's just a card game, then even I have a shot at winning… All right, I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Would you care to join us for a round of President?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text: What? Me?! W-wow, I can't believe I'm getting a direct invitation from Yaeno Muteki… Yes, please! I'd love to join!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Count me in too! There's nothin' like a good ol' competition to get Edo blood pumpin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Righty-o, let da games begin!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pass. Your turn.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan C
text_block_list.text: She chose to pass?! But why? We're only halfway through the game… Is she out of cards? Wait, could she be hiding an ace up her sleeve?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan C
text_block_list.text: Gah… I can't get a read on her! Her face is an unflinching mask!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: How do ya like this?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: Hmph! If that's your play, then—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what's this aura I feel? It's coming from Yaeno Muteki!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: Heh… Hehe… I see. This crushing pressure must be a warning for me not to get too cocky… Very well! I accept your challenge!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's my turn. Take this.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: What?! That threatening aura was just a ploy to make me fumble! Argh, how foolish I was!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, well, well. Could this be the end of the road for the Peerless Poker Face?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: This's my chance!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: Curses… Pass!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That was my last card.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Dang… Looks like I played right into yer hands. Guess I lost, fair 'n' square!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Victory has been decided! Yaeno wins!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text: I-I can't believe it! I got to hear Yaeno Muteki's "Osu!" in person! Awesome!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: I've learned much of my own shortcomings through this test of mettle against you, Yaeno Muteki. Thank you for your guidance!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It wasn't my intention to lend you guidance, but I'm glad you were able to gain something from this.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text: I had a blast playing with you! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The time I spent with you today was very meaningful to me as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Having personally interacted with you all, I'm sure your faces will come to mind whenever I run in a race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Having a concrete image to associate with my fans gives me yet more strength to work hard.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To all those who came to speak to me today, I offer my utmost gratitude and humbly ask for your continued support.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan C
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! You really are so sincere and polite! But you don't have to ask me twice! Or even once! I'll definitely keep cheering for you no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Seems we've come to the moment of truth. Now, how to proceed…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan C
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's going on?! Why's the air suddenly feel so thick and heavy? Gah! What immense pressure!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: This aura must be coming from Yaeno Muteki and Inari One!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: Ngh… What overwhelming force! I didn't think a no-holds-barred competition could go this far!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text: S-so this is the world of competition that Yaeno Muteki contends in!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: …Pass.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now's my chance!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That was my last card!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Dang it, my read on you was totally wrong… You got me good!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Victory's decided! Yaeno wins!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki, you were incredible! To say I was blown away by your spirit during the match would be an understatement!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you. However, I apologize I wasn't able to speak in a more engaging manner.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text: That's okay! I was still able to read your emotions through the energy you gave off during the game!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan C
text_block_list.text: Same here… I feel like I know you better now that I've played with you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Why, what a thought! Though, I suppose that makes sense, as I am my truest self during a competition.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What a joy it is to know you were able to see my real self! I don't believe there is a greater delight than this!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I shall not forget any one of you, nor the heated battle we fought today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I daresay your faces will come to mind whenever I race from now on!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: From the bottom of my heart, I thank you all! And I humbly ask for your continued support!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan C
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I didn't know you could be so passionate! What an unexpected surprise. The more I learn about you, the bigger a fan I'm become!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Inari, Tamamo—thank you both. Because of you, I was able to get to know my fans.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't mention it! Everybody's got stuff they aren't good at, and it's just human nature to help each other out!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: 'Sides, everyone loved the event, so I'd say we're even!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm indebted to you both. If either of you ever need help, please come to me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Man, you're serious as ever! I like that about ya, though!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Getting to interact with her fans seems to have been a great source of encouragement for Yaeno Muteki!
